modified_caption: Token Routing Distribution for FedHLM: The pie chart illustrates the proportion of tokens routed across three categories: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. The LOCAL category dominates with approximately 94.5% of the distribution, while EDGE_P2P and LLM account for roughly 5.5% and 2.5%, respectively. Notably, the EDGE_P2P category has shown a steady increase in its share compared to previous analyses, surpassing LLM in token routing. The chart provides a clear visual representation of these proportions, with percentage labels inside each slice for clarity.
